svg.aria-label: Sketch: a large Canadian flag on a pole fills the top of the frame, its maple leaf at centre, with Alberta flags to the left and right, in front of the fluted stone columns and entablature of the Alberta Legislature in Edmonton. At right a figure in a round hat, full mask and armour holds the pole with both hands; at centre a hooded figure in a striped jersey is seen from behind; a row of heads in the crowd at lower left and the building's steps across the bottom. No faces are drawn. Drawn after a Canadian Press photograph on Global News.
